items.hed: Texans are on the road Sunday at Tennessee, noon Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 11, as an away game at the Tennessee Titans, Nissan Stadium in Nashville, noon Central, on CBS. The next listed date is Sunday, Oct. 18, at Jacksonville in London, 8:30 a.m. Central. Kickoff has not happened. No final is on the club page.

items.hed: Astros still have no general manager as Espada's contract runs out this month
items.insight: MLB.com reports the club parted ways with general manager Dana Brown on Aug. 24. Assistant general managers Charles Cook, Gavin Dickey, and Connor Huff, with senior advisor Jeff Bagwell, have carried the work, and owner Jim Crane is overseeing baseball operations. Nearly a week after the White Sox eliminated Houston in two games in the American League Wild Card Series, MLB.com says the search is unchanged. The club won the AL West at 81-81. Manager Joe Espada's contract expires at the end of October. He said last week he would like to return. No decision is posted.

items.hed: Rockets play Dallas again in Macao on Sunday
items.insight: The NBA.com box score page for Friday, Oct. 9, lists Houston against Dallas in Macao as a preseason game at 8 a.m. Eastern. The page title confirms the matchup and the date. The readable text does not print a final score, so none is stated here. The club still lists a second preseason game in Macao on Sunday, Oct. 11. Rosters for opening day are set Oct. 19 at 5 p.m. Eastern. The regular season starts Oct. 20.
